title: Resistor network, Bourns 4600X SIP, bussed (101 circuit)
readingTypes: 46nnX_101_vvv: nn the pin count, vvv the resistance code (151 = 150 ohm, 272 = 2.7 kohm)
pinRule: pin 1 is the common bus; resistor k runs from pin 1 to pin k+1, so a 4606X has 6 pins and 5 resistors
values: resistance code: first two digits significant, third the number of zeros (151 = 150 ohm)
datasheet: Bourns 4600X datasheet, page 2, Bussed Resistors (101 Circuit)

sources.document: Bourns 4600X Series Thick Film Conformal SIPs, REV. 10/1/20

note: Datasheet: 3 to 13 resistors of equal value, each between the common bus (pin 1) and a separate pin; 4 to 14 pins; 0.20 W per resistor at 70 C.
